protocol_approach: 与 moeshin 同族超星排课 JSON 路: fetch /admin/pkgl/xskb/queryKbForXsd 拿 xhid/xqdm, fetch /admin/xsd/xyjc/getXsjbxx 自动取当前学期 (result.data.dqxnxq, 失败再 #xnxq1 option 手选), 再 /admin/pkgl/xskb/sdpkkbList 取数组; Parser 侧做冲突课合并 (mergeConflictingCourses) 与非连续节次拆分
exact_regex_or_code_snippet: const path = "/admin/pkgl/xskb/queryKbForXsd"; ... const response = await fetch("/admin/xsd/xyjc/getXsjbxx"); if (result.ret === 0 && result.data && result.data.dqxnxq) { xnxq = result.data.dqxnxq; } ... return fetch("/admin/pkgl/xskb/sdpkkbList?" + new URLSearchParams({xnxq, xhid, xqdm})).then((data) => { return data.map((info) => { return { name: cleanTag(info.kcmc), teacher: cleanTag(info.tmc), position: cleanTag(info.croommc), sections: info.djc, weeks: info.zcstr.split(",").map(Number), day: info.xingqi }; }); });
verdict_reason: 超星排课接口族二次实锤且更完整 (新增 /admin/xsd/xyjc/getXsjbxx 学期自动发现 + zcstr 逗号周次串), 字段族 kcmc/tmc/croommc/djc/xingqi 与仓 2 同源; queryKbForGrdb/kckbData/LessonArray 同样 0 命中
